title: Constraint Satisfaction Problems
overview: Solve problems defined by variables, domains, and constraints using backtracking and constraint propagation.
objectives: Formulate a problem as a CSP
Apply forward checking and arc consistency

method.title: Formulation
method.body: A CSP has variables, a domain of values for each, and constraints restricting allowed combinations.

method.title: Backtracking
method.body: Assigns one variable at a time and undoes assignments that violate constraints.

method.title: Propagation
method.body: Forward checking and arc consistency prune domains early and detect dead ends sooner.

method.title: Heuristics
method.body: Choosing the most constrained variable and least constraining value greatly reduces search effort.
